# Code of Conduct

## Our Commitment

We want UI Vault to be a welcoming and respectful open-source project for
everyone.

We expect all contributors and community members to interact respectfully.

## Expected Behavior

Examples of positive behavior include:

- Being respectful and considerate.
- Giving constructive feedback.
- Accepting different opinions and approaches.
- Helping other contributors.
- Focusing on what is best for the project.

## Unacceptable Behavior

Examples of unacceptable behavior include:

- Harassment or discrimination.
- Personal attacks.
- Trolling or intentionally disruptive behavior.
- Publishing private information without permission.
- Any behavior that is inappropriate in a professional community.

## Reporting

If you experience or witness unacceptable behavior, please report it to the
project maintainers through the project's GitHub repository.

All reports will be reviewed as appropriate.

## Enforcement

Project maintainers may remove, edit, or reject contributions or interactions
that violate this Code of Conduct.

Thank you for helping keep UI Vault welcoming and open to everyone.
